items.title: When is an aggregate really anonymous? Differencing attacks on AI query layers
items.description: A sum is not anonymization. Whether a number over special-category personal data (Art. 9 GDPR) says something about one person does not depend on its shape but on the population behind it. If fewer than k people stand behind a number, the aggregate is a single-person disclosure in table form.
